title: Does Context Matter? ContextualJudgeBench for Evaluating LLM-based Judges in Contextual Settings
authors_zh: Austin Xu、Srijan Bansal、Yifei Ming、Semih Yavuz、Shafiq Joty
paper_type_zh: 上下文条件 LLM-as-a-Judge 基准
best_for_zh: 需要 RAG、摘要或上下文依赖评审数据的研究者
one_line: ContextualJudgeBench supplies 2,000 context-dependent response pairs that test whether LLM judges apply conditional factuality, completeness, refusal, and conciseness criteria.
ContextualJudgeBench 提供约 2K RAG 与摘要比较样本，以忠实性、完整性等上下文条件评测 judge 的推理反馈质量。
why: It makes explicit the evidence and conditional criteria a judge must use, rather than scoring isolated answers.
inclusion_reason: ContextualJudgeBench publicly releases context-grounded preference evaluation data for LLM judges.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Common LLM-judge benchmarks provide only a question and candidate responses, omitting source documents that determine correctness in RAG and summarization. Judges may prefer fluent but unfaithful answers and fail when faithfulness, completeness, and contextual relevance must be assessed together.

ContextualJudgeBench constructs about 2,000 difficult context-grounded response pairs across RAG and summarization and eight evaluation slices, using existing human annotations and controlled model perturbations to create verifiable conditional labels for faithfulness, completeness, and related criteria.

常见 LLM judge benchmark 只给问题和候选回答，忽略 RAG 与摘要任务中决定正确性的源文档。模型可能偏爱流畅但不忠实的回答，也可能在需要同时比较事实忠实性、完整性和上下文相关性时失败。

ContextualJudgeBench 构造约 2,000 个带上下文的困难 response pairs，覆盖 RAG 和摘要、八个评测切片，并通过已有人工标注与受控模型扰动产生可核验的忠实性、完整性等条件标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ContextualJudgeBench constructs about 2,000 difficult context-grounded response pairs across RAG and summarization and eight evaluation slices, using existing human annotations and controlled model perturbations to create verifiable conditional labels for faithfulness, completeness, and related criteria. The official dataset contains about 2K records, each with a source context, request or query, two candidate responses, an evaluation criterion, and a chosen label, plus RAG/summarization source and perturbation metadata. The object is which response is better under the given context and should not be reused as context-free general preference data.

ContextualJudgeBench 构造约 2,000 个带上下文的困难 response pairs，覆盖 RAG 和摘要、八个评测切片，并通过已有人工标注与受控模型扰动产生可核验的忠实性、完整性等条件标签。官方数据集约 2K 条，每条包含上下文文档、请求或查询、两个候选回答、评价准则和 chosen label，并标记 RAG/摘要来源与扰动类型。数据重点是“在给定 context 下哪个回答更好”，不能脱离源文档作为一般偏好对使用。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Select source documents, queries, and high-quality responses from RAG and summarization data with human quality or faithfulness annotations.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Apply controlled omissions, contradictions, and unsupported additions to construct a worse candidate on the target contextual criterion.
  1. Verify and filter: Form eight task/criterion slices, filter ambiguous pairs, and retain context, candidates, labels, and generation provenance.
  1. Train and evaluate: Evaluate 11 dedicated judges and seven general models with order-swapped consistent accuracy, penalizing positional bias and unstable judgments.

1. 建立数据源： 从具有人工质量或忠实性标注的 RAG 与摘要数据中选取源文档、查询和高质量回答。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 对回答施加遗漏、矛盾、无依据补充等受控扰动，构造只在目标 context criterion 上较差的候选。
  1. 验证与筛选： 组合八个任务/准则切片并过滤歧义 pair，保留 context、候选、标签和生成来源。
  1. 训练与评测： 评测 11 个专门 judge 与 7 个通用模型，采用交换候选顺序的一致准确率，惩罚位置偏差和不稳定判断。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 18 evaluated models, even o1 achieves only about 55% consistent accuracy, indicating that the contextual hard pairs are not saturated. Many judges drop sharply when context is removed, response order is swapped, or criteria change, directly showing that context-free judge scores cannot substitute for conditional RAG or summarization evaluation. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.
在 18 个评测模型中，即使 o1 的一致准确率也约为 55%，说明带 context 的 hard pairs 尚未被饱和。许多 judge 在不提供上下文、交换回答顺序或切换准则后显著下降，直接证明普通无上下文 judge 分数不能替代 RAG/摘要的条件化评价。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior judge benchmarks mostly test general helpfulness or isolated factual correctness. ContextualJudgeBench includes the full source document and criterion in the feedback contract and uses order-swapped consistent correctness as its main metric, exposing context neglect and positional bias.
已有 judge benchmark 多测通用帮助性或单一事实正确；ContextualJudgeBench 把完整源文档和 criterion 纳入 feedback contract，并用顺序交换后的“一致正确”作为主指标，专门暴露 context neglect 与位置偏差。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Controlled perturbations may be more local than real RAG failures and underrepresent missing retrieval, conflicting evidence, and long-context truncation.
  1. Feedback risk: Human source labels and automatic perturbations may use different quality standards, so aggregate scores across eight slices require care.
  1. Reproduction and use: Public pairs can contaminate judge training; deployment evaluation should retain private documents and new perturbations.

1. 覆盖边界： 受控扰动可能比真实 RAG 失败更局部，未充分覆盖检索缺失、冲突证据和长上下文截断。
  1. 反馈风险： 人工源标签与自动扰动可能使用不同质量标准，跨八个切片的总分需谨慎解释。
  1. 复现与使用： 公开 pair 容易被 judge 训练污染，部署评测应保留私有文档和新扰动。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Evaluate RAG and summarization judges for faithfulness, completeness, and actual use of context.
  1. Training: Swap candidate order before selecting an automatic evaluator and reject models with poor consistent accuracy.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Reuse the perturbation pipeline for private enterprise-document benchmarks; the contract is unsuitable without reliable source context.

1. 评测： 评测 RAG/摘要 judge 的忠实性、完整性和 context 使用能力。
  1. 训练： 在选择自动评审器前执行候选顺序交换，并以 consistent accuracy 淘汰位置偏差模型。
  1. 迁移或部署： 复用扰动流程创建企业文档私有 benchmark；若无可靠源文档，不适合使用该评价合同。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: ContextualJudgeBench constructs about 2,000 difficult context-grounded response pairs across RAG and summarization and eight evaluation slices, using existing human annotations and controlled model perturbations to create verifiable conditional labels for faithfulness, completeness, and related criteria.
  1. Method takeaway: Apply controlled omissions, contradictions, and unsupported additions to construct a worse candidate on the target contextual criterion. Form eight task/criterion slices, filter ambiguous pairs, and retain context, candidates, labels, and generation provenance.
  1. Data takeaway: The official dataset contains about 2K records, each with a source context, request or query, two candidate responses, an evaluation criterion, and a chosen label, plus RAG/summarization source and perturbation metadata.
  1. Evidence anchor: Across 18 evaluated models, even o1 achieves only about 55% consistent accuracy, indicating that the contextual hard pairs are not saturated.
  1. Reuse decision: Evaluate RAG and summarization judges for faithfulness, completeness, and actual use of context. The main risk is that controlled perturbations may be more local than real rag failures and underrepresent missing retrieval, conflicting evidence, and long-context truncation.

1. 一句话定位： ContextualJudgeBench 构造约 2,000 个带上下文的困难 response pairs。
  1. 方法抓手： 对回答施加遗漏、矛盾、无依据补充等受控扰动。组合八个任务/准则切片并过滤歧义 pair。
  1. 数据抓手： 官方数据集约 2K 条。
  1. 证据锚点： 在 18 个评测模型中。
  1. 复用决定： 评测 RAG/摘要 judge 的忠实性、完整性和 context 使用能力。最大风险是受控扰动可能比真实 RAG 失败更局部。
